content:
Following up on my earlier question about spectral graph lemmas —
I'm happy to share that the formalization is now complete!

Repository: https://github.com/zeekmartin/topostability-lean4

What's been proved (all sorry-free, axioms: propext + Classical.choice + Quot.sound):

Paper 12 — Cheeger-type lower bound via triangle structure:

  • cheeger_inequality: h(G)²/(2Δ) ≤ λ₂(L) ← may be useful for Mathlib
  • cut_multiplication, lambda2_lower_bound

Paper 11 — Spectral identity + upper bound:

  • spectral_identity: tr(L·A²) = Σdᵢ² − 6T
  • lambda2_upper_bound_regular

Paper 13 — Triangle graph spectral dominance:

  • lambda2_triangle_graph_le: λ₂(T(G)) ≤ λ₂(G) for d-regular graphs

@Laura Monk — this directly overlaps with your Cheeger inequality goal!
The sweep-cut formalism (sweepCut, crossing, discrete_coarea)
needed to prove Cheeger was the hardest part. Happy to share/discuss
before any Mathlib PR.
